ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Compatibility (Bodge Jobs)
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Multiplayer Team; fork by Zapdude
ModMetaData.description:
Fork of Multiplayer Compatibility for RimWorld 1.6, maintained in the Multiplayer Bodge Jobs repository. The project is MIT licensed; PATCHES.md lists the fork's changes and their upstream status, NOTICE.md records provenance.
Requires Multiplayer Bodged, the fork of Multiplayer.
Adds sync for the customization commit of Persona Weapons Unbound and Unique Weapons Unbound, and guards the Vanilla Fishing Expanded handler against the Odyssey build.
